answer_1.quote: In this paper, we design natural attack triggers by using an adversarially regularized autoencoder (ARAE)...

answer_2.quote: We employ three simple defense metrics to measure the naturalness of attacks: 1. Word frequency... 2. The average per-token cross-entropy loss under a pre-trained language model - GPT-2. 3. Automatic grammar checkers...

answer_4.quote: To further validate that our attacks are more natural than baseline, we perform a human-subject study on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to compare pairs of triggers and select the more natural one, or to determine if a piece of text is naturally generated.
